articles.title: Tokyo Gas (TSE:9531) Stock May Be 29% Undervalued On Cash Flow
articles.summary: Tokyo GasLtd has seen a powerful five year run that leaves many investors asking whether the current share price is still grounded in the cash the business can realistically generate. With the stock recently at ¥6,782, the core issue is whether its cash flows support where the market now values the company. articles.title: Britain's Octopus Energy to spin out Kraken at $8.65 billion valuation
articles.summary: Britain's Octopus Energy said on Monday it will spin off its technology arm, Kraken, as an independent ​company valued at $8.65 billion, after a funding round led by ‌U.S. investment firm D1 Capital Partners. New and existing investors will buy about $1 billion of equity in Kraken. Investors led by Octopus Capital will also inject an additional $320 million into Octopus Energy, the company ⁠said in a statement.
